seg.2b6b229e651e.src: FSSAI's standard says turmeric powder must be free from added colouring matter, including lead chromate, and from foreign starch. Its testing manual lists what inspectors check turmeric for: added dyes such as metanil yellow, lead salts, and chalk powder.
seg.2b6b229e651e.t: FSSAI को मापदण्डअनुसार बेसार धुलोमा लेड क्रोमेटसमेत कुनै पनि थपिएको रङ पदार्थ, र बाहिरी स्टार्च हुनुहुँदैन। यसको परीक्षण पुस्तिकामा निरीक्षकहरूले बेसारमा के-के जाँच्छन् भनेर लेखिएको छ: मेटानिल येलोजस्ता थपिएका रङ, लेडका लवण, र चकको धुलो।
seg.2b6b229e651e.back: According to FSSAI's standard, turmeric powder must not have any added colouring matter, including lead chromate, or foreign starch. Its testing manual writes what inspectors check in turmeric: added colours like metanil yellow, salts of lead, and chalk powder.

seg.b27088069a9d.src: Some of this you can check in your kitchen, and some only a lab can find. This guide covers both, plus two popular tests that do not work for turmeric. Try them on any turmeric you buy, ours included.
seg.b27088069a9d.t: यीमध्ये केही तपाईं आफ्नै भान्सामा जाँच्न सक्नुहुन्छ, र केही ल्याबले मात्र पत्ता लगाउन सक्छ। यो गाइडमा दुवै छन्, साथै बेसारमा काम नगर्ने दुई चर्चित परीक्षण पनि। तपाईंले किन्ने जुनसुकै बेसारमा, हाम्रोमा पनि, यी जाँच गरेर हेर्नुहोस्।
seg.b27088069a9d.back: Some of these you can check in your own kitchen, and some only a lab can detect. This guide has both, as well as two popular tests that do not work on turmeric. Try these checks on any turmeric you buy, ours too.

seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.src: Two glasses of water after the turmeric check. Left: pale yellow water with the powder settled at the bottom. Right: strong yellow water with yellow trails running down from the powder.
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.t: बेसार जाँचपछिका पानीका दुई गिलास। बायाँ: फिक्का पहेँलो पानी, धुलो पिँधमा बसेको। दायाँ: गाढा पहेँलो पानी, धुलोबाट तलतिर पहेँला धर्सा झरेका।
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.back: Two glasses of water after the turmeric check. Left: pale yellow water, powder settled at the bottom. Right: deep yellow water, yellow streaks falling downward from the powder.

seg.c8b6eb5f9530.src: ⟦1⟧The water check⟦/1⟧Left: the powder has settled and the water is pale yellow. Right: strong yellow trails ran from the powder as it sank, and the water turned deep yellow. That one is worth a lab test.
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.t: ⟦1⟧पानीको जाँच⟦/1⟧बायाँ: धुलो पिँधमा बसेको छ र पानी फिक्का पहेँलो छ। दायाँ: धुलो डुब्दै गर्दा त्यसबाट गाढा पहेँला धर्सा झरे, र पानी गाढा पहेँलो भयो। त्यसलाई ल्याबमा जाँच गराउनु उचित हुन्छ।
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.back: ⟦1⟧The water check⟦/1⟧Left: the powder has settled at the bottom and the water is pale yellow. Right: as the powder was sinking deep yellow streaks fell from it, and the water became deep yellow. It is proper to get that tested in a lab.

seg.a7363cc3fa37.src: Sprinkle a teaspoon of turmeric on a glass of water and let it settle without stirring. Turmeric sinks and leaves the water pale yellow; water that turns strong yellow straight away points to added colour. This check cannot find lead chromate or chalk, so for a sure answer, use a food testing lab. Skip the iodine test: turmeric is starchy to begin with.
seg.a7363cc3fa37.t: एक गिलास पानीमाथि एक सानो चम्चा बेसार छर्नुहोस् र नचलाई बस्न दिनुहोस्। बेसार डुब्छ र पानी फिक्का पहेँलो रहन्छ; तुरुन्तै गाढा पहेँलो हुने पानीले थपिएको रङतिर संकेत गर्छ। यो जाँचले लेड क्रोमेट वा चक पत्ता लगाउन सक्दैन, त्यसैले पक्का जवाफका लागि खाद्य परीक्षण ल्याब प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। आयोडिन परीक्षण नगर्नुहोस्: बेसारमा सुरुदेखि नै स्टार्च हुन्छ।
seg.a7363cc3fa37.back: Sprinkle one small spoon of turmeric on top of a glass of water and let it sit without stirring. The turmeric sinks and the water stays pale yellow; water that turns deep yellow immediately points toward added colour. This check cannot detect lead chromate or chalk, so for a sure answer use a food testing lab. Do not do the iodine test: turmeric has starch from the start.

seg.34d6f989bfaf.src: Such as metanil yellow, which can make dull turmeric look brighter. FSSAI does not allow added colour in turmeric.
seg.34d6f989bfaf.t: जस्तै मेटानिल येलो, जसले फिक्का बेसारलाई चम्किलो देखाउन सक्छ। FSSAI ले बेसारमा रङ थप्न अनुमति दिँदैन।
seg.34d6f989bfaf.back: Such as metanil yellow, which can make pale turmeric look bright. FSSAI does not permit adding colour to turmeric.

seg.042cabe54b01.src: Lead chromate and other lead salts
seg.042cabe54b01.t: लेड क्रोमेट र लेडका अन्य लवण
seg.042cabe54b01.back: Lead chromate and other salts of lead

seg.8310b11eab8b.src: Lead chromate is a yellow pigment used in paint. Stanford-led studies published in 2019 and 2024 found it in turmeric from parts of South Asia. FSSAI does not allow it in turmeric at all.
seg.8310b11eab8b.t: लेड क्रोमेट पेन्टमा प्रयोग हुने पहेँलो रङ हो। 2019 र 2024 मा प्रकाशित, स्ट्यानफोर्डको अगुवाइमा भएका अध्ययनहरूले दक्षिण एसियाका केही भागका बेसारमा यो भेटे। FSSAI ले बेसारमा यसलाई पटक्कै अनुमति दिँदैन।
seg.8310b11eab8b.back: Lead chromate is a yellow colour used in paint. Stanford-led studies published in 2019 and 2024 found it in turmeric from some parts of South Asia. FSSAI does not permit it in turmeric at all.

seg.4278e7c5416c.src: A cheap white powder that adds weight.
seg.4278e7c5416c.back: A cheap white powder that increases weight.

seg.5a8b446bbce0.src: Flour or starch from other crops. FSSAI's standard rules it out too.
seg.5a8b446bbce0.t: अन्य बालीको पिठो वा स्टार्च। FSSAI को मापदण्डले यसलाई पनि निषेध गर्छ।
seg.5a8b446bbce0.back: Flour or starch of other crops. FSSAI's standard prohibits this too.

seg.1b1af7f63ffd.src: Fill a clear glass with water at room temperature.
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.t: पारदर्शी गिलासमा कोठाको तापक्रमको पानी भर्नुहोस्।
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.back: Fill a transparent glass with room-temperature water.

seg.653731f2ed6f.src: Sprinkle one level teaspoon of turmeric powder on top. Do not stir.
seg.653731f2ed6f.t: माथिबाट एक बराबर भरिएको सानो चम्चा बेसार धुलो छर्नुहोस्। नचलाउनुहोस्।
seg.653731f2ed6f.back: Sprinkle one level-filled small spoon of turmeric powder from above. Do not stir.

seg.ea5b43cf8436.src: Watch the first minute as the powder sinks. Look for coloured trails running down from it.
seg.ea5b43cf8436.t: धुलो डुब्दै गर्दा पहिलो एक मिनेट हेर्नुहोस्। त्यसबाट तलतिर रङीन धर्सा झरेका छन् कि हेर्नुहोस्।
seg.ea5b43cf8436.back: Watch the first one minute as the powder sinks. See whether coloured streaks are falling downward from it.

seg.e37698aaa3fb.src: Leave it for 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass against a white wall or a sheet of paper and look at the water above the settled powder.
seg.e37698aaa3fb.t: 15 देखि 20 मिनेटसम्म छोड्नुहोस्। त्यसपछि गिलासलाई सेतो भित्ता वा कागजको पानाअगाडि समातेर पिँधमा बसेको धुलोमाथिको पानी हेर्नुहोस्।
seg.e37698aaa3fb.back: Leave for 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass in front of a white wall or sheet of paper and look at the water above the powder settled at the bottom.

seg.e8937cebf136.src: Pale yellow water, powder at the bottom
seg.e8937cebf136.back: Pale yellow water, powder at the bottom

seg.256ce5cf303d.src: Strong yellow trails, or deep yellow water within minutes
seg.256ce5cf303d.t: गाढा पहेँला धर्सा, वा केही मिनेटमै गाढा पहेँलो पानी
seg.256ce5cf303d.back: Deep yellow streaks, or deep yellow water within a few minutes

seg.ce06c8148072.src: Possible added colour. Stop using that batch and get it tested.
seg.ce06c8148072.t: रङ थपिएको हुन सक्छ। त्यो ब्याच प्रयोग गर्न छोड्नुहोस् र जाँच गराउनुहोस्।
seg.ce06c8148072.back: Colour may have been added. Stop using that batch and get it tested.

seg.53d9c5db264d.src: ⟦1⟧Why it works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow, curcumin, hardly dissolves in water, so the powder sinks and only tints the water. Dyes such as metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water fast.
seg.53d9c5db264d.t: ⟦1⟧यो किन काम गर्छ।⟦/1⟧ बेसारको आफ्नै पहेँलो रङ, करक्युमिन, पानीमा मुस्किलले घुल्छ, त्यसैले धुलो डुब्छ र पानीलाई हल्का मात्र रङ्याउँछ। मेटानिल येलोजस्ता रङ सजिलै घुल्छन् र पानीलाई छिटो रङ्याउँछन्।
seg.53d9c5db264d.back: ⟦1⟧Why this works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow colour, curcumin, barely dissolves in water, so the powder sinks and colours the water only lightly. Colours like metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water quickly.

seg.af4442c6e910.src: ⟦1⟧What it misses.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk do not dissolve in water either, so turmeric mixed with them can pass this check. Only a lab test can rule them out.
seg.af4442c6e910.t: ⟦1⟧यसले के छुटाउँछ।⟦/1⟧ लेड क्रोमेट र चक पनि पानीमा घुल्दैनन्, त्यसैले यिनी मिसाइएको बेसार यो जाँचमा पास हुन सक्छ। ल्याब परीक्षणले मात्र यी छैनन् भनेर पक्का गर्न सक्छ।
seg.af4442c6e910.back: ⟦1⟧What this misses.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk also do not dissolve in water, so turmeric mixed with these can pass this check. Only a lab test can confirm these are not there.

seg.a8b61850b87d.src: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for a while. Cloudy is fine; a clear, strong yellow is what to look for.
seg.a8b61850b87d.t: धेरै मसिनो धुलोले केही बेर पानी धमिलो राख्न सक्छ। धमिलो हुनु ठीकै हो; हेर्नुपर्ने कुरा सफा, गाढा पहेँलो रङ हो।
seg.a8b61850b87d.back: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for a while. Being cloudy is fine; the thing to look for is a clear, deep yellow colour.

seg.c3455d1f4c96.src: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric
seg.c3455d1f4c96.back: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric

seg.3d4e366bb488.src: Snap a finger of dried turmeric in half. Turmeric is yellow-orange right through, so the inside should look much like the outside. A bright yellow skin over a pale or dull core can mean colour was added to the surface. Ask the seller about it, or get it tested.
seg.3d4e366bb488.t: सुकेको बेसारको एउटा गानो बीचबाट भाँच्नुहोस्। बेसार भित्रसम्मै पहेँलो-सुन्तला रङको हुन्छ, त्यसैले भित्री भाग बाहिरी भागजस्तै देखिनुपर्छ। फिक्का वा धमिलो भित्री भागमाथि चम्किलो पहेँलो बोक्रा छ भने सतहमा रङ थपिएको हुन सक्छ। यसबारे बेच्नेलाई सोध्नुहोस्, वा जाँच गराउनुहोस्।
seg.3d4e366bb488.back: Break one dried turmeric finger from the middle. Turmeric is yellow-orange coloured all the way inside, so the inner part should look like the outer part. If there is a bright yellow skin over a pale or dull inner part, colour may have been added on the surface. Ask the seller about this, or get it tested.

seg.4c4dc95561d2.src: Iodine turns blue-black when it meets starch, and it is often suggested for spotting flour in turmeric. But turmeric is starchy itself, so it turns blue-black either way. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test for powdered spices other than turmeric.
seg.4c4dc95561d2.t: स्टार्च भेट्दा आयोडिन नीलो-कालो हुन्छ, र बेसारमा पिठो पत्ता लगाउन यो प्रायः सुझाइन्छ। तर बेसारमा आफैँ स्टार्च हुन्छ, त्यसैले जसरी पनि नीलो-कालो हुन्छ। त्यसैकारण FSSAI को आफ्नै पुस्तिकाले आयोडिन परीक्षण बेसारबाहेक अन्य धुलो मसलामा प्रयोग गर्छ।
seg.4c4dc95561d2.back: Iodine turns blue-black when it meets starch, and it is often suggested to detect flour in turmeric. But turmeric itself has starch, so it turns blue-black anyway. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test on ground spices other than turmeric.

seg.fc16ff8016e3.src: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use concentrated hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. They belong in a lab, not a kitchen.
seg.fc16ff8016e3.t: बेसारमा लेड, मेटानिल येलो र चक जाँच्ने FSSAI का परीक्षणमा कडा हाइड्रोक्लोरिक वा सल्फ्युरिक एसिड प्रयोग हुन्छ। यी एसिडले छाला र आँखा पोल्छन्। यिनको ठाउँ भान्सा होइन, ल्याब हो।
seg.fc16ff8016e3.back: FSSAI's tests that check for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use strong hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. Their place is the lab, not the kitchen.

seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.src: For a sure answer: a food testing lab
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.t: पक्का जवाफका लागि: खाद्य परीक्षण ल्याब
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.back: For a sure answer: a food testing lab

seg.1883beca4d73.src: A NABL-accredited food testing lab can test turmeric for lead and for added colours. Ask the lab how much sample it needs, keep the powder in its sealed pack or a clean sealed bag, and note the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI publishes a list of notified food testing labs on its website.
seg.1883beca4d73.t: NABL मान्यताप्राप्त खाद्य परीक्षण ल्याबले बेसारमा लेड र थपिएका रङ जाँच्न सक्छ। ल्याबलाई कति नमुना चाहिन्छ सोध्नुहोस्, धुलोलाई सिल गरिएकै प्याकमा वा सफा सिल गरिएको झोलामा राख्नुहोस्, र प्याकमा छापिएको ब्याच नम्बर टिप्नुहोस्। FSSAI ले आफ्नो वेबसाइटमा सूचित खाद्य परीक्षण ल्याबहरूको सूची प्रकाशित गर्छ।
seg.1883beca4d73.back: An NABL-accredited food testing lab can check turmeric for lead and added colours. Ask the lab how much sample it needs, keep the powder in its sealed pack or in a clean sealed bag, and note the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI publishes a list of notified food testing labs on its website.

seg.456379c75c24.src: Read the pack before you buy

seg.ff7951e2f36b.src: An FSSAI licence or registration number. You can look it up on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.
seg.ff7951e2f36b.t: FSSAI इजाजतपत्र वा दर्ता नम्बर। यसलाई FSSAI को FoSCoS वेबसाइटमा खोज्न सकिन्छ।
seg.ff7951e2f36b.back: FSSAI licence or registration number. This can be searched on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.

seg.476e4849c1d8.src: The name and address of whoever made or packed it.
seg.476e4849c1d8.t: बनाउने वा प्याक गर्नेको नाम र ठेगाना।
seg.476e4849c1d8.back: Name and address of the maker or packer.

seg.beee8eda6466.src: Net quantity, MRP, a batch or lot number, and a best-before date.
seg.beee8eda6466.t: खुद परिमाण, MRP, ब्याच वा लट नम्बर, र बेस्ट-बिफोर मिति।
seg.beee8eda6466.back: Net quantity, MRP, batch or lot number, and best-before date.

seg.f9270fd96202.src: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions differs in colour, so a named region helps you compare like with like.
seg.f9270fd96202.t: कहाँ उब्जाइएको हो। फरक क्षेत्रको बेसारको रङ फरक हुन्छ, त्यसैले क्षेत्रको नाम लेखिएको भए उस्तै-उस्तैसँग तुलना गर्न सजिलो हुन्छ।
seg.f9270fd96202.back: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions differs in colour, so if the region's name is written it is easier to compare like with like.

seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.src: Keep the pack zipped shut, or move the powder to a dry, airtight jar.
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.t: प्याकको जिप बन्द राख्नुहोस्, वा धुलोलाई सुख्खा, हावा नछिर्ने बट्टामा सार्नुहोस्।
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.back: Keep the pack's zip closed, or move the powder to a dry, airtight container.

seg.bb4d61f86b55.src: Use a dry spoon. A damp spoon is what makes turmeric lumpy.
seg.bb4d61f86b55.t: सुख्खा चम्चा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। ओसिलो चम्चाले नै बेसारमा डल्ला पार्छ।
seg.bb4d61f86b55.back: Use a dry spoon. A damp spoon itself makes lumps in turmeric.

seg.a92c022ff52e.src: Keep it out of direct sunlight, which fades the colour.
seg.a92c022ff52e.t: सिधा घामबाट टाढा राख्नुहोस्, घामले रङ फिक्का पार्छ।
seg.a92c022ff52e.back: Keep away from direct sun, sun makes the colour pale.

seg.6911ce63edde.src: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?
seg.6911ce63edde.t: धेरै चम्किलो पहेँलो बेसार नराम्रो संकेत हो?
seg.6911ce63edde.back: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?

seg.a0ce62cee740.src: Not by itself. Colour changes with the variety, where it was grown and how it was dried and ground, so turmerics differ a lot. What matters is colour that leaves the powder too easily, as in the water check.
seg.a0ce62cee740.t: त्यत्तिकै होइन। रङ जात, उब्जाइएको ठाउँ, र कसरी सुकाइयो र पिँधियो भन्नेअनुसार फरक हुन्छ, त्यसैले बेसार-बेसारमा धेरै फरक हुन्छ। ध्यान दिनुपर्ने कुरा: रङ धुलोबाट धेरै सजिलै छुट्छ कि छुट्दैन, पानी जाँचमा देखिए जस्तै।
seg.a0ce62cee740.back: Not by itself. Colour differs according to variety, place grown, and how it was dried and ground, so it differs a lot from turmeric to turmeric. The thing to pay attention to: whether the colour comes off the powder very easily or not, as seen in the water check.

seg.e8cc5edbb092.src: Can the water check show that turmeric has no lead?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.t: के पानीको जाँचले बेसारमा लेड छैन भनेर देखाउन सक्छ?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.back: Can the water check show that there is no lead in turmeric?

seg.37eb38df9ce8.src: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water check cannot see it. Only a lab test can.
seg.37eb38df9ce8.t: सक्दैन। लेड क्रोमेट पानीमा घुल्दैन, त्यसैले पानीको जाँचले यसलाई देख्न सक्दैन। ल्याब परीक्षणले मात्र सक्छ।
seg.37eb38df9ce8.back: It cannot. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water check cannot see it. Only a lab test can.

seg.4c0bb3e9657c.back: Why do lumps form in turmeric?

seg.2b76cd3e665b.src: Moisture. A wet spoon or an open pack lets the powder take in water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack sealed.
seg.2b76cd3e665b.t: चिस्यानले। भिजेको चम्चा वा खुला प्याकले धुलोलाई पानी सोस्न दिन्छ। सुख्खा चम्चाले डल्ला फुटाउनुहोस् र प्याक बन्द राख्नुहोस्।
seg.2b76cd3e665b.back: From moisture. A wet spoon or an open pack lets the powder absorb water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack closed.

seg.87fe2929801d.src: What should I do if a check looks wrong?
seg.87fe2929801d.t: जाँचमा केही गडबड देखियो भने के गर्ने?
seg.87fe2929801d.back: What to do if the check shows something wrong?

seg.e83aba6cc6df.src: Stop using that batch, keep the pack, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also report it to FSSAI through its Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the pack and the glass.
seg.e83aba6cc6df.t: त्यो ब्याच प्रयोग गर्न छोड्नुहोस्, प्याक राखिराख्नुहोस्, र ब्याच नम्बरसहित बेच्नेलाई सम्पर्क गर्नुहोस्। FSSAI को Food Safety Connect एपमार्फत उजुरी पनि गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ। हाम्रो हो भने प्याक र गिलासको फोटो हामीलाई WhatsApp गर्नुहोस्।
seg.e83aba6cc6df.back: Stop using that batch, keep the pack, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also complain through FSSAI's Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the pack and the glass.

seg.1dd4194330b1.src: Try these checks on ours too. If anything looks off, ⟦1⟧WhatsApp us⟦/1⟧ a photo with the batch number from the pack.
seg.1dd4194330b1.t: हाम्रो बेसारमा पनि यी जाँच गरेर हेर्नुहोस्। केही ठीक नलागे प्याकको ब्याच नम्बरसहित फोटो ⟦1⟧हामीलाई WhatsApp गर्नुहोस्⟦/1⟧।
seg.1dd4194330b1.back: Try these checks on our turmeric too. If something does not seem right, ⟦1⟧WhatsApp us⟦/1⟧ a photo with the pack's batch number.
